description: Toll Facilities in the U.S.: Roads is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. The tolls facility program provides information on U.S. toll facilities in operation, financed, or under construction that States and various toll authorities voluntarily provide to FHWA biennially. It captures the name, financing or operating authority, location and termini, length, and road system for toll roads, bridges, tunnels, and ferries that connect highways. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 28 columns, among them Maximum Pass. Fee, Toll Collection Both Ways, Toll Collection One-Way (N,S,E,W), Rural/Urban, State, Electronic Toll Collection Kind. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last data update. Attribution given: FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
